resources.string:
While monitoring is on, ArenaHub Companion will:

- record your screen (no microphone, no camera) and send it to the tournament API server, only if the referee turned recording on for this match,
- report the Mobile Legends or CODM signing certificate and install source for staff comparison,
- check for apps on the tournament blocklist (including tools that can change game files), root access, screen-control (accessibility) apps, apps that draw over games, and debugging settings,
- report every 15 seconds while the match window is open, using little battery.

It does not read your messages, photos, contacts, location, passwords or other apps' content. Listed app matches, configured signing-certificate matches, enabled screen-control services and overlay apps are reported, never your full app inventory.

Reports and recordings go to the tournament server shown on the consent screen and are deleted after 30 days unless staff place an evidence hold. Recordings can include private notifications; close personal apps first. You can stop at any time; stopping is logged for the referee, and a referee decides what happens next. Declining is not a penalty: you can play on an organizer device instead.
